text:
jack_csm: Heads-up 1: CobaltBank QBR booked for Wed Jun 11 10:30am PT. We need a compact deck (8-9 slides) covering onboarding progress, usage trends, renewal risk, and an enablement plan. I'll drop a draft in the shared drive in 30m.

hana_cs: I'll take onboarding velocity and activation cohorts. Do we have the cohort export for trial->paid by week? I recall some gaps for the May cohort.

leo_se: I'll own the demo slide + runbook for execs. Planning to show a short 90s flow of the integration and a fallback demo video. Who from SRE can standby for the live demo?

terry_sre: I can standby for the demo window but not the whole QBR. Also will provide a short SLO blurb and a current incident summary. Quick SLO snapshot: 95p=180ms, 99p=420ms, error_rate=0.08% (as of 2025-06-05).

billing-bot: Billing flag: CobaltBank dispute opened on invoice INV-2025-042 on 2025-05-28. Status: under review. Contact: accounting@cobaltbank.com.

jack_csm: Good call on the billing line. For renewal risk I want a simple heatmap: financial, technical, adoption. Hana, can you map customers in those buckets? Add notes for accounts with support tickets >3 in last 30d.

hana_cs: Will do. I already have a list of open tickets. For CobaltBank specifically they had two onboarding tickets and one integration timeout error. I'll flag the timeout under technical risk.

leo_se: For the demo slide I'm adding two variants: live integration (preferred) and recorded flow (fallback). Also adding a single-slide appendix called "how we remedied timeouts" with recent config change and canary results.

jack_csm: Exec asks I'm proposing: 1) Approve a 6-week enablement play (CS + SE hours) targeted at top 5 at-risk customers; 2) Approve temporary credits for customers with billing disputes to keep usage steady; 3) Approval to ship an improved onboarding checklist next sprint. Thoughts?

terry_sre: 1) Ops okay to support the canary + runbook for 6 weeks (1 engineer on rotational standby, not full FTE). 2) Credits need to go through finance; I can provide thermal impact of credits on MRR if helpful.

billing-bot: Finance contact: rachel_fin. Estimate impact: issuing $10k in credits reduces MRR recognition this quarter by $8.2k (rough). Please route approval request via finance channel.

jack_csm: Noted. We'll keep the ask as a signoff to explore credits and route formal approval through finance. For the deck: please keep each slide to one key message + one call to action.

hana_cs: Action items I'm tracking so far:
- Hana: cohort activation slide + risk buckets (due Mon 5pm PT)
- Leo: demo + runbook + fallback video (due Tue EOD)
- Terry: SLO blurb + incident digest + appendix slide (due Tue EOD)
- Jack: Exec asks + invite + rehearsal schedule (will set)

invite-bot: Meeting created: QBR  CobaltBank | Wed Jun 11 2025 10:30am PT | 30m  jack_csm, hana_cs, leo_se, terry_sre  https://calendar.redwood/qbr-cobaltbank

jack_csm: Can we do a 20min rehearsal Wed 9:30am PT? Need a hard run-through to time the demo.

leo_se: 9:30 rehearsal works. I'll mute desktop notifications during the demo and upload the fallback video link into the deck.

terry_sre: I'll join rehearsal and bring the latest latency png. Also will prepare one slide with mitigation timeline (weeks 0-2 hotfix, weeks 3-6 adoption nudges).

hana_cs: Will upload the cohort CSV to the shared drive now. If anyone needs additional segmentation (by integration type), ping me.

jack_csm: Thanks all. Last ask: if any of you see a material renewal risk that needs an exec PSA (legal/billing/contract terms), post it here before Tue EOD so we can decide whether to escalate. Avoid scare language but be explicit about actions needed.

leo_se: FYI one customer in the top-10 list mentioned contract term mismatch during onboarding. I'll DM legal and summarize here if they recommend executive outreach.

billing-bot: Reminder: escalate invoice disputes to #finance-escalations if legal review is required.

jack_csm: Cool. I'll assemble v1 of the deck after rehearsal notes and post for a 10-min async review before the QBR. :rocket:
